cloud_agent_create_description: Runs on Pi with your cloud computer’s default model, ready to chat as soon as it’s made. An existing default cloud computer is reused.

agent_create_local_description: Runs on your own computer, ready to chat as soon as it’s made. Keep the computer online to use it.
